structural_relation.EXACT: Exact SHA-256 binary match across instances

semantic_relation.OVERLAP: Identical functional capability (e.g. 2 different Tailwind CSS tools)
semantic_relation.COMPLEMENTARY: Synergistic workflow steps (e.g. Audit then Fix)

ecosystem_relation.DIFFERENT: Targets different runtimes (e.g. Python vs Go)

lineage_relation.PARENT_CHILD: One skill is a specialization of another

advisory_rule: No automated destructive collapsing is permitted during extraction. Skills with semantic overlap retain independent provenance.
